TVC Campaign : No More Excuse
This campaign was created to remind and reinforce to homeowners nationwide that home -related issues should 
never be overlooked and that there is no excuse for postponing necessary care or repairs . A home is the most 
important living space in our lives, one that stays with us and our families for a lifetime.

## Page 8

Grand Opening “JOMOO Showroom” –October 24, 2025
TOA joins forces with JOMOO, a world -class sanitary ware brand, to launch the first fully integrated “ Smart Bathroom Solution ” 
showroom in the heart of Sukhumvit 26. This milestone reinforces TOA’s vision of being “More Than Paint,” as the company 
expands into the Smart Toilet market in response to the growing mega -trends of health consciousness and an aging society.
Marketing Activities (4)

## Page 9

SHARING HAPPINESS PROJECT
TOA shares happiness through the “ SHARING HAPPINESS ” project  bringing color, brightening smiles, and transforming the 
playground for children at Ban Rachawadee (Home for persons with disabilities protection and development -boys), Nonthaburi 
Province. 
This playground was further developed from the winning design of the Color Design Award under the concept “Play -Part -Park,” 
created by Mr. Krittitee Trinet and Mr. Thanaphat Jinwong , students from the Faculty of Architecture, Chulalongkorn University, in 
collaboration with Dr. Punjapat Thirathumrongwee .
